newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Ukraine offers space, military technology to Africa.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine offers space, military technology to Africa.

text.p: Ukraine's ambassador to South Africa on Thursday offered his country's space technology to African countries to explore marine resources and monitor weather patterns.

"Ukraine is world famous for production of certain types of space equipment which is of the highest technological level," Ambassador Leonid Guryanov told delegates at an international trade exhibition.

"Broad opportunities exist for cooperation in this field, with possible employment of Ukrainian space technology and space vehicles by African clients with the purpose of exploring (the) sea shelf and earth monitoring," Guryanov added.
Embassy officials said Ukrainian space technology, including satellites, could be used by African countries to map marine and mineral resources.
Guryanov also said there was space for increased trade, including in the military field.
"The advantages of the establishment of direct trade relations between Ukraine and African countries cannot be exaggerated," he said.

"Ukraine is ready to offer to our counter partners different types of combat vehicles... We can offer different types of navy, infantry and air force weapons systems. There are good prospects of using here, in Africa, the huge rocket and missile building potential of Ukraine both (for) military and peaceful purposes," he added.
Guryanov said his country was interested in using South African mining expertise, with the possibility of cooperating on future joint ventures.
